title: Discharge summary note from F1: every section written + planted facts recalled
hypothesis: The Discharge summary template produces a complete note that captures the session's key facts.

sections.title: Course of treatment
sections.html:
Dates and exact number of sessions were not assessed this session.

Treatment utilized Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) with a focus on treating Panic Disorder (F41.0), addressing catastrophic cognitions regarding panic symptoms, utilizing thought records, and conducting interoceptive exposure.

sections.title: Progress toward goals
sections.html: The client demonstrated progress in identifying catastrophic thoughts, noting a decrease in belief ratings from 90% in the moment to 40% afterward when reviewing a panic attack at the grocery store. The client also successfully engaged in interoceptive exposure during the session, experiencing a decrease in anxiety from a rating of 6 to 3 within two minutes.

sections.title: Recommendations
sections.html:
• Continue completing thought records three times per week
  • Practice the interoceptive spinning exercise once a day at home
  • Practice returning to the grocery store on a quiet morning and staying until anxiety decreases by half
  • Continue medication management with primary care provider regarding sertraline
